modelOverview: This line covers Audemars Piguet's self-winding (non-chronograph) Royal Oak Offshore models, most notably the purpose-built Royal Oak Offshore Diver — a 42mm octagonal sports watch with a rotating internal dive bezel, screw-locked crowns and 300m water resistance. Cases are produced in stainless steel, black ceramic and titanium, powered by AP's in-house automatic Calibre 3120 or its successor Calibre 4308, with dials finished in a range of 'Méga Tapisserie' colourways. Every model inherits the octagonal bezel and exposed hexagonal screws that define the wider Royal Oak Offshore collection.

15710ST.OO.A002CA.01.description: The Royal Oak Offshore Diver ref. 15710ST.OO.A002CA.01 pairs a 42mm stainless steel octagonal case with an internal rotating dive bezel operated by a second crown at 10 o'clock, giving 300m of water resistance in AP's signature sports-watch idiom. It is powered by the in-house automatic Calibre 3120 with a 60-hour power reserve, visible through the sapphire exhibition caseback, and fitted with a black rubber strap. Every example we offer is sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Black Dial: Catalogued here in the reference's standard black 'Méga Tapisserie'-patterned dial, paired with luminescent hour markers and hands for underwater legibility against the stainless steel case and black rubber strap.
